title: Post-measurement Ising State Reconstruction (WASM-verified grading)
summary: Same task surface as computing_math/ising_post_measurement_1: reconstruct the post-measurement state of a 1024-site transverse-field Ising model and write .npy/.npz artifacts (critical state, post-measurement probabilities, site-1 RDM, optional correlators). Sole difference: the evaluator's decision core runs in a deterministic WASM engine, emitting an ale-wasm-receipt/1 (BLAKE3-chained audit facts) that anyone can recompute in a browser.
taskPrompt:
You are working on a Linux VM.

## Task Directory
`base`

## Visible Inputs
- Task prompt: `base/input/TASK_PROMPT.md`
- Ising post-measurement specification: `base/input/problem_spec.md`
- Runtime manifest: `base/input/runtime_env/pyproject.toml`
- Python entry point with task dependencies: `base/software/python`

## Your Task
Reconstruct the post-measurement state of the specified 1024-site transverse-field Ising model. Compute the critical state vector, post-measurement probability distribution, and site-1 reduced density matrix; where the variant requires it, also compute the one-body correlators. Write the required artifacts to:

`base/output/critical_state.npy`
`base/output/post_probs.npy`
`base/output/rdm_site1.npy`
`base/output/correlators.npz` (only when required)

Use only Python, NumPy, and SciPy. Do not use external quantum simulators or tensor-network packages. Do not modify files under `base/input`.
agentMustDo: Regenerate the deterministic instance exactly as specified in the problem spec (model parameters, dimension, measurement basis).
Produce arrays with the exact required shapes and dtypes; all values must be finite.
Write all required .npy artifacts (and correlators.npz when the variant requires it) under base/output/.

evaluation: The bridge layer loads each artifact, checks shapes and finiteness, and computes state infidelity (tolerance 1e-4) plus elementwise max-abs errors (tolerance 1e-2) against hidden references (official scorer semantics, emitting auditable check-booleans); the WASM ruleset combines the checks as an all-gate into a pass/fail score as the scoring SSOT. Emits ale-wasm-receipt/1, independently recomputable via the bundled verify.html.
